description: KSMPPD - all servers, per server, per customer (ESME) and per bind

panels.title: KSMPPD servers
panels.description:
One row per ksmppd server: reachability, uptime, customers known since start, customers connected now, active binds, current submit / deliver / error rate, open acks, queued PDUs, the PDU load ksmppd itself reports for the last 60 s, and how long the status scrape took.

Follows the Server filter.

panels.title: Peak Inbound (msg/s)
panels.description:
Highest submit rate of all selected servers combined. Peak = highest 1-minute average inside the selected time range; Current = last minute.

Inbound / Submit = submit_sm the customer sends to ksmppd (MT accepted + MT rejected). Outbound / Deliver = deliver_sm ksmppd delivers to the customer (DLR + MO).

Follows the Server filter.

panels.title: Peak Outbound (msg/s)
panels.description:

Follows the Server filter.

panels.title: Current Inbound (msg/s)
panels.description:

submit_sm per second from the selected customers (accepted + rejected).

panels.description:

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description:
submit_sm per second that ksmppd rejected (error response to the customer: throttled, invalid, no route, no credit ...).

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Error %
panels.description:
Rejected submits as % of all submits. Green < 2 %, orange 2-5 %, red > 5 %.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Submitted (range)
panels.description:
All submit_sm (accepted + rejected) in the selected time range.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Errors (range)
panels.description:
Rejected submit_sm in the selected time range.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Customers connected
panels.description:
Customers with at least one bind right now.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Customers disconnected
panels.description:
Known customers with NO bind right now - they cannot send traffic.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Active binds
panels.description:
Total SMPP binds (sessions) open by the selected customers.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Bind utilisation
panels.description:
Active binds as % of the maximum binds allowed. At 100 % new binds are refused.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Open acks
panels.description:
PDUs sent to customers that are not yet acknowledged (in flight). Growing = slow customer.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Queued PDUs
panels.description:
PDUs waiting in the inbound + outbound queues of the binds. Should be close to 0.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Pending routing
panels.description:
Submitted messages waiting for a route decision. Should be 0.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: DLR ratio
panels.description:
Delivery reports delivered as % of MT accepted (over the graph interval). Low = operator DLRs missing or late.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: TPS limit (sum of customers)
panels.description:
Sum of max-inbound-load of the selected customers.

TPS model: max-inbound-load = TPS limit of the customer - the same whether 1 or all max-binds sessions are connected. Achieved TPS = inbound (submit_sm accepted + rejected) + outbound (DLR + MO) per second, 1-minute average. Utilisation = achieved / limit. Customers with limit 0 (unlimited) show no utilisation.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Customer overview

Status = CONNECTED if at least one bind.
State for = time in the current state.
Binds / Max binds / IPs = sessions now, allowed, source IPs.
TPS limit = max-inbound-load (whole customer). TPS util % = (inbound + outbound msg/s, 5 min) / TPS limit.
Submit/s, Deliver/s = last 5 min.
(range) = within the selected time range. Error % = errors / submits.
Open acks / Queued = in flight / waiting.
Last reconnect = age of the newest bind.

max by (server, esme) (sum by (server, esme) (increase(ksmppd_esme_dlr_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])))
max by (server, esme) (sum by (server, esme) (increase(ksmppd_esme_mo_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])))

max by (server, esme) (100 * sum by (server, esme) (increase(ksmppd_esme_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])) / clamp_min((sum by (server, esme) (increase(ksmppd_esme_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])) + sum by (server, esme) (increase(ksmppd_esme_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range]))), 1))
max by (server, esme) (sum by (server, esme) (ksmppd_esme_queued{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}))

max by (server, esme) (100 * (sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[5m])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[5m])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_mo_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[5m])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_dlr_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[5m]))) / on (server, esme) (ksmppd_esme_throughput_limit{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"} > 0))

panels.title: Top 10 customers by MT (range)
panels.description:
Customers with the most accepted MT in the range.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Top 10 customers by errors (range)
panels.description:
Customers with the most rejected submits in the range.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Top 10 error % (range, >100 msgs)
panels.description:
Worst error %; customers with 100 or fewer submits are hidden.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

targets.expr: topk(10, 100 * sum by (server, esme) (increase(ksmppd_esme_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])) / ((sum by (server, esme) (increase(ksmppd_esme_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range])) + sum by (server, esme) (increase(ksmppd_esme_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__range]))) > 100))

panels.title: Submit rate per customer
panels.description:
Submits per second per customer (stacked).

Inbound / Submit = submit_sm the customer sends to ksmppd (MT accepted + MT rejected). Outbound / Deliver = deliver_sm ksmppd delivers to the customer (DLR + MO).

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

targets.expr: (sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0

panels.title: Deliver (DLR+MO) rate per customer
panels.description:
Deliveries per second per customer (stacked).

Inbound / Submit = submit_sm the customer sends to ksmppd (MT accepted + MT rejected). Outbound / Deliver = deliver_sm ksmppd delivers to the customer (DLR + MO).

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

targets.expr: (sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_mo_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_dlr_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0

panels.title: Error rate per customer
panels.description:
Rejected submits per second per customer.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Error % per customer
panels.description:
Rejected as % of submitted per customer over time.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) / ((sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

panels.title: Achieved TPS per customer vs limit
panels.description:
Achieved TPS (inbound + outbound) of each customer next to its TPS limit (max-inbound-load).

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

targets.expr: (sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_mo_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_dlr_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0

ksmppd_esme_throughput_limit{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"} and on (server, esme) ((sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_mo_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_dlr_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

panels.title: DLR ratio per customer (DLR / MT)
panels.description:
Delivery reports as % of accepted MT per customer.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_dlr_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (server, esme) (rate(ksmppd_esme_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Customer connection state (history)
panels.description:
Green = CONNECTED, red = DISCONNECTED per customer over time.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Binds per customer
panels.description:
Open binds per customer over time; dips = binds dropped.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Binds & drops per customer
panels.description:
Bars up = new binds, bars down = binds that disappeared. Flapping customers show many of both.

Follows the Server and Customer filters. Also follows the Bind type filter.

panels.title: Open acks & queued per customer
panels.description:
In-flight acks, queued PDUs and PDUs pending routing per customer.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Transceiver binds (TRX)
panels.description:
Open TRX binds - submit and receive DLR/MO on the same session.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Transmitter binds (TX)
panels.description:
Open TX binds - submit only.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Receiver binds (RX)
panels.description:
Open RX binds - receive DLR/MO only.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Binds (range)
panels.description:
New binds seen in the selected range (reconnects).

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Drops (range)
panels.description:
Binds that disappeared in the selected range. Orange > 5, red > 50.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Simulate-mode binds
panels.description:
Binds running in ksmppd simulate mode (test traffic, not sent to operators). Should be 0 in production.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Bind details
panels.description:
Share of TPS limit % = (inbound + outbound msg/s of this session) / customer TPS limit. Every open bind: id, source IP, type, age, current rates (5 min), last-second PDU load, open acks, queues, routing and counters since the bind connected.

Inbound / Submit = submit_sm the customer sends to ksmppd (MT accepted + MT rejected). Outbound / Deliver = deliver_sm ksmppd delivers to the customer (DLR + MO).

Follows the Server, Customer, Source IP and Bind type filters.

targets.expr: max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (ksmppd_bind_uptime_seconds{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"})
max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (ksmppd_bind_open_acks{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"})

max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) ((sum by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (rate(ksmppd_bind_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m])) + sum by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (rate(ksmppd_bind_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m]))))

max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) ((sum by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (rate(ksmppd_bind_mo_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m])) + sum by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (rate(ksmppd_bind_dlr_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m]))))

max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (sum by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (ksmppd_bind_load_pdus_per_second{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type", direction="inbound"}))

max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (sum by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (ksmppd_bind_load_pdus_per_second{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type", direction="outbound"}))
max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (sum by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (ksmppd_bind_queued{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}))
max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (ksmppd_bind_pending_routing{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"})
max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (ksmppd_bind_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"})
max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (ksmppd_bind_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"})
max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (ksmppd_bind_dlr_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"})
max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (ksmppd_bind_mo_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"})
max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (ksmppd_bind_simulate{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"})

max by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (100 * (sum by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (rate(ksmppd_bind_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m])) + sum by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (rate(ksmppd_bind_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m])) + sum by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (rate(ksmppd_bind_mo_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m])) + sum by (server, esme, bind_id, ip, type) (rate(ksmppd_bind_dlr_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m]))) / on (server, esme) group_left () (ksmppd_esme_throughput_limit{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme"} > 0))

panels.title: Connections by source IP
panels.description:
Binds and rates per customer source IP.

Follows the Server, Customer, Source IP and Bind type filters.

targets.expr: max by (server, esme, ip) (ksmppd_esme_ip_binds{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip"})

max by (server, esme, ip) ((sum by (server, esme, ip) (rate(ksmppd_bind_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m])) + sum by (server, esme, ip) (rate(ksmppd_bind_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m]))))

max by (server, esme, ip) ((sum by (server, esme, ip) (rate(ksmppd_bind_mo_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m])) + sum by (server, esme, ip) (rate(ksmppd_bind_dlr_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[5m]))))
max by (server, esme, ip) (sum by (server, esme, ip) (ksmppd_esme_ip_load_pdus_per_second{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", direction="inbound"}))

panels.title: Submit rate per bind
panels.description:
Submit rate of each bind - shows load balancing across a customer's sessions.

Follows the Server, Customer, Source IP and Bind type filters.

targets.expr: (sum by (esme, bind_id) (rate(ksmppd_bind_mt_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (esme, bind_id) (rate(ksmppd_bind_errors_total{server=~"$server", esme=~"$esme", ip=~"$ip", type=~"$bind_type"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0

panels.title: Binds by type
panels.description:
Open binds by bind type over time.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Bind age (newest bind per customer)
panels.description:
Age of each customer's most recent bind; drops to 0 on reconnect.

Follows the Server and Customer filters.

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description:
Time the exporter needs to read each status page.

Follows the Server filter.

panels.title: Scrape errors / min
panels.description:
Failed status page reads per minute.

Follows the Server filter.

panels.description:
Grows while a server's status page is unreachable.
